title: Algorithms
author: Jeff Erickson
description: A rigorous algorithms textbook built from the author's courses at the University of Illinois. Covers recursion, dynamic programming, greedy algorithms, graphs, NP-hardness, and more, emphasizing intuition and the problem-solving process alongside formal proofs.
